Overview

Baní is a city in 04 with a population of 120,000. A coastal city known for its salt flats, beaches, and as the birthplace of Dominican poet Gastón Deligne. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
